content.comment_body: Hello, After installing [product_name] [version_no] on my new PC (Windows 11), I encounter an error. How can this be fixed? Regards.
Hi, Try checking this video online—it might offer some guidance.
Hi, Thanks, but this did not resolve the issue. The problem continues even after applying the suggested changes. Regards, [user_name].
Check your Java configuration. Java 8 is generally compatible with [product_name]; I'm not sure about Java 11. I reran the installer for [product_name], and everything worked fine.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report a startup error when launching [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 11 due to a Java Virtual Machine issue. The error blocks access to the application, interfering with users' work. Attempts to fix the issue using generic videos and modifications were unsuccessful, and no solution is found in the discussion.
